title: Pin the git credential helper text to the image's, like the tk shim
description:
The restore installs a copy of image/common.sh install_git_credential_helper (both the token-door and static variants, same decision condition) so a fresh container can fetch a private remote. It is the same drift problem the boundary-guard tk shim had: nothing fails when the image's helper changes. The tk shim solved it by pinning the refusal in contracts/worker-boot-contract.json and asserting both sides in tests; the helper text deserves the same treatment (a contracts pin + an assertion in internal/sandboximage and the harness node suite).
evidence: harness/src/workspace/checkpoints.ts CREDENTIAL_HELPER_STATIC/CREDENTIAL_HELPER_TOKEN_DOOR vs image/common.sh install_git_credential_helper (lines 1046-1060)
